s1.i1: This Cookie Policy explains how JungleVPN uses cookies and similar tracking technologies across our website, Telegram bot, and applications (together, the "Service"), and how you can control them.
s1.i2: Cookies are small files stored on your device that let a site or app remember information about your visit. We use cookies set directly by us ("first-party") and cookies set by services we rely on ("third-party").
s1.i3: Wherever we rely on your consent, you can withdraw it at any time — see Section 5, Managing Your Preferences.

s2.i1_lead: Necessary cookies — required for the Service to work and always active:
s2.i1_u1: keeping you signed in and remembering your language and interface preferences;
s2.i1_u2: recognizing a referral code or marketing link you arrived with, so it can be credited correctly.
s2.i2_lead: Measurement cookies — used only once you accept them, to understand how the Service is used and to find and fix problems:
s2.i2_u1: page views, feature usage, and error and crash diagnostics, collected through PostHog (see Section 3).

s3.i1: PostHog is the analytics and tracking service we use across the Service. It provides product analytics, session replay, and error tracking so we can understand usage and fix bugs.
s3.i2_u1: pages viewed, features used, and buttons clicked;
s3.i2_u2: a replay of on-screen interactions — clicks, scrolling, and typing activity; text typed into input fields is masked and never captured;
s3.i2_u3: device and browser type, approximate location derived from your IP address, and console error logs.
s3.i3: PostHog processes this data in the European Union. Before you respond to the cookie banner, it is collected without a persistent identifier ("cookieless mode"); once you accept, your activity across visits is linked to build a fuller picture of how the Service is used.

s4.lead: The table below lists the cookies our website currently sets.

s5.i1: When you first visit, a banner lets you accept or decline measurement cookies. Declining does not stop the Service from measuring anonymous usage — it only prevents PostHog from linking that activity to a persistent identifier.
s5.i2: You can change your choice at any time by clearing your browser's cookies and site data for our domain, which brings the banner back.
s5.i3: Most browsers also let you view, block, or delete cookies directly in their settings (for example, Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge each have a "Cookies and site data" section). Blocking necessary cookies may prevent parts of the Service from working.

faq.title: Questions before you connect?

q1.question: How do I set up JungleVPN?
q1.answer: Install HAPP on your device, open your personal JungleVPN subscription link, and import it into the app. Your connection settings are added automatically, so there is no need to configure servers manually. In most cases, setup takes only a few minutes.

q2.question: Which devices can I use JungleVPN on?
q2.answer: JungleVPN works on all platforms. One subscription can be used across all your devices, so you can protect your phone, laptop and other supported devices with a single plan.

q3.question: What does the 3-day free trial include?
q3.answer: The free trial gives you access to JungleVPN before you commit to a paid subscription. No credit card is required to start. You can test the connection, available server locations and everyday performance before deciding whether to continue.

q4.question: What happens if I am not satisfied after purchasing?
q4.answer: JungleVPN includes a 30-day money-back guarantee. If the service is not right for you, contact our support team within the eligible refund period and we will guide you through the refund process according to the applicable terms.

faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about setup, devices, privacy and your subscription.

q5.question: What information does JungleVPN collect?
q5.answer: JungleVPN is designed with privacy in mind and aims to minimise unnecessary data processing. We clearly explain what information is required to operate your account, subscription and service in our Privacy Policy, including how it is used and retained.

what.title: What Is a VPN?
what.subtitle: A VPN (Virtual Private Network) creates an encrypted connection between your device and a VPN server, helping protect your traffic and reduce the amount of connection information visible to your internet provider and local networks.

encryption.title: Encryption
encryption.description: Your internet traffic is encrypted before it leaves your device and remains protected until it reaches the VPN server. This helps reduce the risk of interception when using public or untrusted networks.

masking.title: IP Address Protection
masking.description: When you connect through JungleVPN, websites see the VPN server’s IP address instead of your home IP address. This adds an additional layer of privacy and lets you connect through available server locations.

tunnel.title: Secure VPN Tunnel
tunnel.description: Your device communicates with the JungleVPN server through an encrypted VPN tunnel. This helps protect your connection on hotel, airport, café and other networks you may not fully trust.

why.title: Why JungleVPN Fits Everyday Life
why.subtitle: Protect your connection at home, while travelling and on public networks — without adding unnecessary complexity to the way you use the internet.

wifi.title: Stay Safer on Public Wi-Fi
wifi.description: Public networks in hotels, airports and cafés aren’t always networks you control. JungleVPN encrypts your connection between your device and the VPN server, helping protect your traffic on untrusted networks.

privacy.title: Keep Your Connection More Private
privacy.description: A VPN helps reduce the amount of connection information visible to your internet provider and local network. Your traffic travels through an encrypted VPN connection instead of directly through the network you are using.

travel.title: Stay Connected While Travelling
travel.description: Use available JungleVPN server locations when you are away from home and need a secure, familiar connection for everyday browsing, work, calls and online services.

smartRouting.title: Smart Routing for Everyday Use
smartRouting.description: Route only the traffic that needs VPN protection while other connections continue directly. This reduces unnecessary switching and helps everyday apps and services work more naturally.
